Volvo is rolling out an over-the-air (OTA) update to bring Apple Music to the infotainment systems in more than 2 million of its vehicles. Details here.

Volvo vehicles receive Apple Music integration via OTA update

Volvo announced an OTA update that will bring Apple Music to the infotainment systems of several models, according to Exame (via MacMagazine).

According to a press release on the carmaker's website, "The software update will apply to the Volvo EX90, ES90, XC90, S90, V90, XC60, S60, V60, XC40, EX40, and EC40, covering model years 2020 and later." The release adds, "Actual availability may vary by model."

To celebrate the integration, eligible customers who have never subscribed to Apple Music in select Volvo vehicles can get 3 months of free service, while former users who have been unsubscribed for at least a month can get 2 months of free service.

Beyond standard Apple Music playback, Volvo EX60, EX90, and ES90 models equipped with the optional Bowers & Wilkins sound system will support Dolby Atmos. The new EX60, which begins deliveries this summer, will also have Apple Music built in natively.

Volvo says that the up to 3-month Apple Music trial offer is available through July 6, 2027. For Volvo's full announcement, see the link here.

Apple Music requires an active subscription. You can subscribe for $11.99 per month, and get the first 1 month free.
